purpose: Localise the first failing stage of the rejected learned-memory path on matched episodes, without another training arm.
hypothesis: Storage recovers under the exact observed key, so the remaining failure is one of query-derived addressing, candidate/value discrimination (including corrections), or native-language use of the frozen fast state. Matched episodes and controls must identify the first failing stage from raw measurements.

episode_contract.matched: The same episode inventory, derived labels and rank/margin/false-recall definitions drive stages 1-4 and every control.
episode_contract.observations: One dated initial page per world; correction/interference worlds add one dated correction page observed strictly later.
episode_contract.queries: One rendered query per observed fact plus one unobserved-address query; all four declared query forms are exercised.
episode_contract.distractors: Independent-world facts from another family in the same split; interference worlds add same-attribute and same-entity near misses.
episode_contract.splits: train/dev/heldout are world-separated; counterfactual variants stay inside one family and split; heldout observed values are disjoint from train/dev.
episode_contract.labels: Expected answers, roles and query kinds are derived by a verifier from observed records and dated corrections. They are never stored in writer, query-encoder, sense or prompt inputs.
episode_contract.exact_observed_key: Stage 1 is a storage upper bound only; it is not addressing capability.

writer_extension.role: frozen rejected writer diagnostic artifact; no optimizer and no weight update may run

generation.memory_arm: Frozen PersistentFastMemory read consumed by MemorySession.prepare/generate; empty source context.
generation.context_removed_arm: Same prompt as the memory arm with fast_state=None; measures whether memory actually changes the answer.
generation.exact_source_arm: Eligible current-view records selected by the query through ExactMemoryReference; observed source text only.
generation.full_context_arm: Every observed page line up to the state cutoff, including the dated correction; no evaluator label.

information_boundary.raw_rows: Raw readout and answer artifacts carry no expected/answer label; the scorer re-derives correctness from verifier labels.
information_boundary.controls: Exact-source and full-context prompts contain only observed source lines. They never receive gold answers, evaluator roles or split metadata.

guard.compatibility: Uses the existing exclusive MPS worker and fallback-off 50 GiB capacity guard unchanged.

stop_conditions: row inventory, token or artifact bound
frozen parameter or save/reload parity failure

decision_rule.first_failure: The first stage in order whose predeclared gates fail is the reported first failing stage.
decision_rule.mechanical_exclusion: Zero updates and mechanical save/reload parity are not a useful-memory stage; failing them invalidates the run instead of selecting a stage.
decision_rule.no_repair_without_evidence: The report names the smallest next measurement discriminator only; it does not propose writer/reader/addressing/integration changes without measured evidence.

limitations: Stage 1 is an exact observed-key storage upper bound, not an addressing capability.
Opaque observed values are not natural language; generation accuracy on them is not a general language-memory claim.
Correction is latest-value append/supersession, not deletion, revocation or neural unlearning.
No training arm runs, so split separation does not test cross-split generalisation.
The frozen rejected v5 writer remains rejected; this package is diagnostic-only and publishes nothing.
Mechanical persistence/reload parity is separate from useful memory.
CPU tiny-adapter tests establish contracts and scoring, not native model quality.
